parsed.summary: Accessible status needs a non-colour cue; the summary hides the failing runs.

issues.problem: Status is colour-only. Put a short marker back in each cell (check / x); it can shrink on narrow screens but shouldn't vanish.
issues.why: A missed failure ships a broken release.
issues.fix: Restore short text markers in the cells (a check for pass, an x for fail). Markers can shorten at narrow widths but must never disappear.
issues.evidence: Cells carry no text, icon or pattern; only fill colour changes.

issues.problem: Pass-first summary hides failures. Lead with the failure count.
issues.why: The summary is what people check before a release.
issues.fix: Lead with failures: "4 failed - 27 passed", with the failure count in --danger #B42318.
issues.evidence: Header reads "27/31 passed" while 4 red cells sit in the matrix.

issues.problem: Muted text #8B93A1 on the white page #FFFFFF is 3.09:1, under the 4.5:1 AA bar for 12-13px text.
issues.why: The last-run times are how people judge whether a failure is current.

answers.question: Can someone find today's failing suites in five seconds?
answers.answer: No: colour alone and a pass-first summary hide them.

answers.question: Does the note band read as part of the page header?
answers.answer: Mostly; it could use a little more separation.
